description: The Helious feed, newest first: the posts Helious publishes (kind post: releases with their surprise, auction results, board updates, the daily brief and live squawk lines) and the wire headlines it carries (kind headline: breaking news, geopolitics, official statements, central bank speakers, bank and business notes). Every item has a stable id, a score and a direction; most carry helious_read, Helious's plain-English line on why it matters. A headline also carries carried_at (when Helious put it on the tape; created_at is when it was published) and a URL-free thread_id that stays the same when a story is retitled. No headline names its outlet, author or link. Depth follows the connected account for the permanent posts: releases, auctions, desk posts, the brief, the minutes. Headlines are kept 7 days whatever the plan (official statements and Fed speakers 400 days), as are squawk lines and the board lanes. Optional q filters by word; categories narrows to chosen lanes; kind narrows to headline or post. Where the account receives news an hour behind: a post from created_at, a headline from the later of created_at and carried_at. A headline names no outlet as its source: a trailing ' - Outlet', a 'via Outlet' credit and the wire's label are removed; a headline about an outlet, or about an index such as the Nikkei, can still mention one.

categories.description: Comma-separated lanes, like release,auction or news,geo. Empty means all.

fresh.description: Set true to ask for the live view of this one call, for 5 credits, where the connected account otherwise receives it an hour behind. Accepted and free where the account is already live. No effect without a key.

kind.description: headline or post. Empty means both.
